description: Search US bridges in the FHWA National Bridge Inventory. Scope with state, county (3-digit FIPS code), and/or condition (Good/Fair/Poor); optional filters: posting_status (open/posted/closed/not_yet_open), owner_code, scour_critical, year_min/year_max, min_adt, route, and q (text match on facility carried, feature crossed, location). Returns decoded records with condition rollup, posting status, clearances, and labels.

county.description: 3-digit FIPS county code within the state

owner_code.description: Agency code of the bridge owner

q.description: Text match: facility carried / feature crossed / location

name: search_bridges
